title: The turmeric stain
premise: Daughter panics about a haldi stain on her white kurta; Mummy gives a remedy, then says it's the old Diwali stain because she wore that kurta.

script.text: Why are you texting me during office hours.
mummy haldi stain on my white kurta. help
Put raw lemon and sit it in the sun.
That stain is from Diwali. Same kurta. I wore it.

caption: old stain

post.caption: Mummy has a stain database. Send this to your mumma.
